# Matt Rutherford Coaching

> Matt Rutherford is a career and leadership coach based in Dublin, Ireland, working online with clients in Ireland, the UK and Europe, and in person by arrangement. Career and leadership coaching for people making progress in their careers: from senior individual contributor to first-time manager, from manager to senior leader, and through the changes in between. Thirty years in senior roles at Meta, LinkedIn and Microsoft, most recently Global Head of Change Management at Meta.

Prices are published and the same whoever pays, including when an employer funds the coaching. The first conversation is free: 45 minutes, online, and not a sales call. Contact: matt@mattrutherfordcoaching.com. Booking: https://calendly.com/mattrutherfordcoaching/conversation

## Packages

- [The Clarity Session](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/coaching/clarity-session/): One decision, one situation, worked through properly in a single sitting. €350 (opening offer). One 90 minute session and a 30 minute follow-up.
- [The Next Move](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/coaching/the-next-move/): For people making a specific career move: stepping up into management, landing the next role, or starting well in a new one. €1,200 (for the programme: €200 a session, or two payments of €600). Six 60 minute sessions over twelve weeks.
- [The Leadership Engagement](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/coaching/leadership-engagement/): For experienced managers and senior leaders growing into a bigger role or leading through change. €3,000 (for six months: eight sessions, or three payments of €1,000). Eight 90 minute sessions over six months.
- [Ongoing Partnership](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/coaching/ongoing-partnership/): For people who want a standing thinking partner, or who want to start with a session or two before committing to a programme. €200 (per session). 60 minute sessions, booked singly or in blocks.

## Situations

- [Just been laid off?](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/laid-off/): Just been laid off or made redundant? What to do in the first 72 hours and two weeks, what can wait, and a free conversation if it helps.
- [New manager](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/new-manager/): First time manager? What to do in your first 90 days, what nobody tells you, where new managers come unstuck, and a free conversation if it helps.
- [New role](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/new-role/): Starting a new job, a promotion or a new employer? How to use your first 90 days in a new role well, and a free conversation if it helps.
- [Leading through change](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/leading-through-change/): Leading a team through a reorganisation or restructure? What people need from you, the order of things, looking after yourself, and a free conversation.
- [Next role](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/next-role/): Looking for your next role? Career coaching for professionals: what you want, your story, the search and the offer, with a free conversation.

- [Coaching](https://mattrutherfordcoaching.com/coaching/): Four career and leadership coaching packages with published prices, from a single Clarity Session to a six month Leadership Engagement.
